title: WebGPU Indirect Draw in Rust: 24,576 Plants with wgpu
description: Render 24,576 plants with 12 indexed indirect WebGPU commands in Rust, wgpu, and WGSL. Learn command buffers, instancing, glTF, and KTX texture arrays.
imageAlt: Dense WebGPU jungle with palms, red bromeliads, green ground cover, and an indirect-draw statistics overlay.
